name: mixed_blocks
description: Mixed PSD+LP block SDP: block 1 is 2x2 PSD (tr=1), block 2 is 1-dim nonneg scalar. max (X_1)_{11}+x_2 s.t. tr(X_1)=1, x_2+x_12=1/2. Optimal value=1+sqrt(2)/2=(2+sqrt(2))/2 (irrational). Tests mixed block_sizes=[2,-1] and irrational optimum.
reference_method: Exact closed form: calculus optimization yields critical point a0=(2+sqrt(2))/4, opt=1+sqrt(2)/2. Verified by Mathematica Maximize.
